correctness.rationale: Exact Kraus duality gives two unbiased transverse effects and a biased longitudinal effect with rank-one negative branch. Each of the three binary pairs is compatible iff q<=1/2 by a spectral norm trace witness or rank-one branch determinant inequalities. A constructed 8-outcome POVM is PSD iff q<=1/3. For necessity, 90-degree rotation twirling equalizes four rank-one z-negative effects, and congruence by (I-qP)^(-1/2) reduces remaining z-positive effects to unbiased orthogonal Pauli POVMs with effective sharpness sqrt(q/(1-q)). The positive trace witness forces q<=1/3. Endpoints q=0, 1 and equalities handled; symbolic verifier replay passed, but finite checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: A physical amplitude-damping semigroup has two distinct exact finite compatibility transition times, ln(2)/Gamma and ln(3)/Gamma, separating pairwise from global compatibility of a natural complete Pauli measurement triad. The full continuum classification and concrete parent measurements provide an operational signature of asymmetric nonunital noise, rather than a small artificial example or a generic textbook observation. No result is claimed for other measurement sets.
